spec.title: `flow:working-rules` — sessions that share a project, and work that ends

p.PACKAGE-INSTALLS-THE-WORKING-RULES: A vibevm `flow` package that installs the working rules for sessions that share one project: who reads which page, how an owner's short request is read, how a frozen completion list lets a campaign end, how a lead with bounded judgement is kept inside its list, and how executors carry out one packet each without deciding anything.

p.EACH-ROLE-READS-ONE-PAGE: Each role reads one short page and nothing else: an open lead reads the protocol, a bounded lead reads its own page, an executor reads the executor page and its packet. Long rule files read literally make a weak reader worse, so the pages are kept separate on purpose.

facts.CONTENT-PROTOCOL: `protocol.md` — the portable protocol: roles and profiles, reading the owner's words, finishing and stopping, split-mode responsibilities, bounded workers, credential isolation, synchronization and emergency preservation.
facts.CONTENT-LEAD-BOUNDED: `lead-bounded.md` — the whole working rules of a bounded lead.
facts.CONTENT-WORKER: `worker.md` and `packet.template.md` — the whole instruction surface of an executor, and the packet a lead writes for it.
facts.CONTENT-DECOMPOSING: `decomposing.md` — how an open lead prepares a completion list that a bounded lead can execute without spiralling: the scout, decompose, skeptic and revise procedure, and the traps a skeptic finds.
facts.CONTENT-RUNS: `runs.md` — the optional contract for managed execution resources.
facts.CONTENT-TEMPLATES: `project.template.md` and `local.template.md` — inactive templates for the two project-owned files.
facts.CONTENT-EXTENSION: `with-multi-user-planning.md` — read only when that planning package is also installed.
facts.CONTENT-THE-BOOT-SNIPPET: `spec/boot/13-flow-working-rules.xml` — the routing table read at session start, plus a fragment that appears only together with the planning extension.

p.PAGES-ARE-OUTSIDE-THE-SPEC-ROOT: The pages live outside the package's spec root so that they reach every consumer byte for byte, whatever spec format the consumer materialises, and keep the installed path the routing table names.

p.THE-PACKAGE-NEVER-WRITES-PROJECT-FILES: Two files belong to the project, at its root: `WORKING-RULES.project.md`, the committed project policy, and `WORKING-RULES.local.md`, the untracked local binding. Installing, updating or removing the package never writes, replaces or activates them. Without them a session works in ordinary mode.
